scope: Bounded independent review of frozen fixture preflight; read-only except this review artifact. No full hash/preflight rerun, original process, GUI, build or external write.

findings.title: Reject ambiguous duplicate XML controller properties
findings.observation: The properties dictionary keeps only the final Property for each Name. Two conflicting DTMAX or HeatingTime entries therefore pass when the last value matches the expected bound. The consumer precedence has not been established here.

reproduction.fixture: Existing synthetic TrialPreflightTests setUp fixture in a temporary directory
reproduction.mutation: Prepend <Property><Name>DTMAX</Name><Value>999</Value></Property> inside Properties before the existing DTMAX=0.1

findings.requested_change: Collect values by Name and require exactly one DTMAX=0.1 and exactly one HeatingTime=0.1 sec. Add an adverse duplicate-value test; include conflicting values and ideally repeated identical values to reject ambiguous declarations.
findings.qualification: This is a preparation checker ambiguity, not evidence that current frozen R4 inputs contain duplicates or that the solver would run unbounded. Runtime execution remains gated separately.
findings.resolution: Resolved: require exactly one matching DTMAX/HeatingTime Property and one Value, rejecting conflicting or equal duplicates. Two new tests cover both orders, equal duplicates and multiple Value entries.
